integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally. [Shot 1] Cinematic Chinese celestial palace, ethereal xianxia realm in the heavenly court, vast architecture dwarfing tiny human figures, three-tier spatial layers: foreground columns/archways framing, middle sea of clouds, background grand palace silhouette at horizon, strict central-axis symmetry, one-point perspective vanishing to infinity, at least one floating structure (sky bridge, cloud terrace, floating island), cold blue-gray low-saturation environment, moon white and ice blue tones, high-saturation warm accents only on character costumes (vermilion, emerald, gold), diffused soft light with ethereal mist, no harsh shadows, descending sacred light beams, subtle rim light on flowing robes, deep blue night sky with cold moonlight, misty atmospheric depth. The camera is static locked shot. A massive floating stone terrace hovers in the deep blue sky, framed by ancient coiled dragon pillars in the immediate foreground. The sky is filled with golden twilight clouds, not cold blue, creating a majestic, warm atmosphere. At 00:00.000, the sea of clouds below the terrace violently splits open. A column of golden light pierces through the mist. From the breach, a formation of four distinct, fantastical iron-winged war machines emerges, flying in a V-shape. The first is a sleek, twin-engine interceptor with sharp, blade-like wings. The second is a massive, silver-gutted transport with a bulbous, armored belly. The third is a quad-rotor drone with complex, layered rotor arms. The fourth is a high-altitude surveillance plane with a large, circular radar dish on its back. They fly in perfect synchronization, their metallic surfaces reflecting the intense golden light, creating sharp highlights and deep shadows. A tiny figure in a flowing vermilion robe stands on the edge of the stone terrace, hand resting on the stone railing, watching the formation. The figure's robe flutters in the wind, matching the movement of the clouds. The clouds swirl around the pillars and the machines, adding a sense of dynamic motion to the static shot. The lighting is high-contrast, with the golden light acting as the primary source, washing over the scene and illuminating the intricate details of the stone and metal. The depth of field is extremely deep, keeping the foreground pillars, the mid-ground machines, and the background clouds all in sharp focus, emphasizing the scale and grandeur of the celestial assembly. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A deep, resonant bass hum vibrates through the air, mixed with the rushing, whooshing sound of dense clouds parting. As the iron-winged machines break through the mist, a sharp, metallic screech and the powerful thrum of massive engines blend into a rhythmic, majestic roar. The sound of wind whips around the stone pillars, creating a continuous, low-frequency rumble. A subtle, ethereal chime resonates in the background, adding a layer of celestial grandeur to the mechanical and atmospheric sounds. The audio is crisp and clear, with a wide dynamic range that emphasizes the scale of the event. The overall soundscape is a blend of natural wind, mechanical power, and mystical resonance, creating a sense of awe and anticipation.
